decision_cruda.rationale: N600-11 stopped 5-8h, so LH-04 is idle. Per RESERVE-01 its loader can activate a reserve. RS-N600-02 is on the same Norte level (11.5 g/t, 419 t, 1h activation), so there is no travel. After activation it has about 5.5 loading hours at 38.5 t/h, or about 190 t, which is about 70 oz. Norte stockpile is 247 of 450 t, so the extra inflow (59+38 vs 66 truck capacity) does not fill it before 17:00. RS-E569-01 grades lower (9.2 g/t) and would need travel. No loans are needed because no producing loader is taken.
